name: DentaQuestD7210PriorAuthLogic
title: DentaQuest D7210 Prior Authorization Determination Logic
description: CQL logic evaluated by the CRD service at order entry: does a D7210 (surgical extraction) order for a Texas Medicaid Adult Dental beneficiary require prior authorization? Returns true for all D7210 orders under this benefit, since surgical extraction is confirmed to always require PA under this plan.
